'''Trevin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] and, hence, a member of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]]. When the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] established a [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|new government]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Trevin and a group of rebellious Moffs supported the deposed [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala's]] campaign to usurp control of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] from [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]. During the [[Battle over Exodo II]], Trevin was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the destruction of his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].
